"Ouroboros" originates from the Ancient Greek *ouroboros*, combining *oura* (tail) and *bora* (food/devouring) to mean "tail-devourer." In parallel, "serpent" stems from the Latin *serpens*, the present participle of *serpere*, meaning "to creep" or "crawl."

Now looking up both terms for further details.
